notes.title: Devil May Cry 4 Special Edition release date, pricing, gameplay trailer, and costumes
notes.notes:
Fun-filled stylish action romp Devil May Cry 4 Special Edition comes to Steam starting June 23, 2015 for $24.99/ €24.99 / £19.99. Additionally, those who pre-order the game will receive bonus costumes for Lady and Trish when the game is released. Pre-order today! 

Speaking of costumes, take a look! 

http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/gregaman/devil_may_cry/f380911941f5daf5b37912edec99c24a.png?v=126000
↑ Lady's classic DMC3 look. This is one of the two costumes unlocked by pre-ordering.

http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/gregaman/devil_may_cry/c3b946b312d21aaba3e00d3129a7dda9.png?v=82800
↑ Trish's ostentatious Gloria disguise. This is the other pre-order costume.

http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/gregaman/devil_may_cry/64a701371f0fe0e41532c8205065577a.png?v=148500

http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/gregaman/devil_may_cry/649ffb4e6864f495132c26b3c3a370e8.png?v=237600

http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/gregaman/devil_may_cry/75812c1f9eff5c411143dec6f0460e54.png?v=93150

http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/gregaman/devil_may_cry/96c0d0291f0a3d270aeb3aa19e9c88de.png?v=109800

http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/gregaman/devil_may_cry/3f6d5f9aa10ddb3286d409ca84b1b612.png?v=136800

We also have a snazzy new trailer showcasing gameplay with all FIVE of the game's playable characters. Enjoy!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ys1TWOKK3k
